summary: refactor(shared): move legacy db config, transformers and mysql to a lib
description:
Because:

- fxa-shared db config, transformers and mysql belong in an nx lib.
- fxa-shared kept a second full copy of db/config.ts.

This commit:

- Adds libs/shared/db/mysql/legacy with config, mysql and transformers.
- Repoints auth-server, admin-server and fxa-shared importers to the alias.
- Ports the transformers test to jest and drops the ./db/mysql export.
- Makes fxa-shared db/config.ts a re-export of the lib config.

Closes FXA-10654
